scripts.build:engine: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --module commonjs --moduleResolution node10 --ignoreDeprecations 5.0 --declaration false --target ES2022
scripts.test: npm run build:engine && npm run test:unit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run quality && npm test && npm run coverage:parsers
scripts.quality: npm run quality:escape-hatches && npm run quality:unused-exports && npm run quality:circular-deps
scripts.coverage:parsers: npm run build:engine && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary --include='dist/src/block-parser.js' --include='dist/src/inline-parser.js' npm run test:unit && node scripts/check-parser-coverage.cjs
scripts.dev:engine: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --module commonjs --moduleResolution node10 --ignoreDeprecations 5.0 --declaration false --target ES2022 --watch --preserveWatchOutput
